questions.question: Which UI technology should the tray app's dashboard and screens use?
questions.context: D1 in docs/prd.md §10 / F-043. It shapes the whole tray codebase (R3, R4, R7 and every later screen), so it is costly to change after M1. Both options run natively on Windows 11 with a Win32 tray icon.

options.label: Dear ImGui + ImPlot (D3D11)
options.description: one small C++ dependency, fast iteration, excellent live charts and big virtualized tables; looks like a dev tool

options.label: WebView2 + HTML/JS UI
options.description: polished CCleaner-like look, rich layout; adds a web toolchain and a JS/C++ bridge

options.label: WinUI 3 (C++/WinRT)
options.description: native Fluent look; heaviest toolchain and slowest iteration

questions.blocks: R4: dashboard: live charts for CPU, memory and each disk, per-drive health cards, volume bars with days-until-full, top process trees
questions.answer: Dear ImGui + ImPlot (D3D11), with a Win32 Shell_NotifyIcon tray icon.
